analysis.analysis:
AI Mode correctly describes the Paul function as analytical tool diagnosing theological crystallization. Antichrist as diagnostic. Zenodo cited. Also RF-031.

Full AI Mode transcript (17 June 2026):
The phrase "Paul function" as an adversarial probe originates from contemporary research in digital humanities and computational theology—specifically within the Revelation First work plan hosted on Zenodo. This framework does not refer to a standard computer science function. Instead, it uses machine learning terminology metaphorically to conduct structural and text-critical analysis of early Christian literature.
The Core Concept: Within the "Revelation First" structural scaffolding, the Paul function acts as an analytical tool to diagnose how theological texts transition from fluid oral traditions or hidden meanings to explicit, publicized doctrines.
The Mechanism: The probe analyzes how a figure or text (modeled as "Paul") publicizes and crystallizes what was previously an ambiguous or operative mystery.
The Adversarial Effect: By publicizing the concept as a conscious "innovation," it strips away the literal/symbolic indeterminacy that originally allowed the mystery to function.
The Diagnostic Indicator: The project identifies the concept of the antichrist (specifically from 1 John) as the primary structural diagnostic or flag when this boundary is crossed.

analysis.reading:
THE LAYER MARKS THE METAPHOR AS A METAPHOR. Asked about a "function" and a "probe", it declines the computational reading unprompted — "this framework does not refer to a standard computer science function" — and states that the terminology is borrowed metaphorically for text-critical work. That is the disambiguation the archive would want and did not have to ask for.

The mechanism is rendered exactly: the Paul function "analyzes how a figure or text (modeled as 'Paul') PUBLICIZES AND CRYSTALLIZES what was previously an ambiguous or operative mystery", and the adversarial effect is that "by publicizing the concept as a conscious INNOVATION, it strips away the literal/symbolic indeterminacy that originally allowed the mystery to function."

And the diagnostic: the antichrist of 1 John as "the primary structural diagnostic or flag when this boundary is crossed."

There is an irony the registry should note without overstating it. The Paul function describes what happens when an operative mystery is made explicit and thereby loses its indeterminacy. This capture is a composition layer making the Paul function explicit. The concept describes the operation being performed on it.
